Your Privacy Matters to Us
At Brooks Integrated Marketing (BrooksIM), we are committed to respecting your privacy and complying with all applicable data protection laws.

As a registered data broker in California and other states, we do not engage directly with individual consumers, nor do we compile data independently. We recognize the importance of giving individuals control over their personal information and the right to delete, opt-out or
